_meta.title: FIXEO Canonical Formula Registry V1 Draft
_meta.note: NOT imported by any runtime. Design artifact only.

analysis.fixed_services: All 31 fixed/conditional-fixed services have integer MAD approved prices. No rounding needed.
analysis.time_based_single_bric002: 150 MAD/h × hours. With 2h minimum → 300 MAD. Possible fractional hours (e.g. 2.5h → 375 MAD). Integer result.
analysis.time_based_team_net002: 65 MAD/cleaner-hour × workers × hours. With workers ∈ {1,2,3} and hours ∈ {1..8}: 65, 130, 195 MAD — always integer.
analysis.unit_multiplication_with_floor_peinture: 35/65/75 × painted_m2 or 45 × ceiling_m2. If m² is integer → integer result. If decimal m² → decimal MAD.
analysis.unit_multiplication_with_floor_net030: 18 × m². If m² is integer → integer. If decimal → may be non-integer.

A_exact_integer.description: Compute exact, round to nearest integer MAD.

B_nearest_5.description: Round final price to nearest 5 MAD.

C_nearest_10.description: Round final price to nearest 10 MAD.

analysis.recommendation: Option A (nearest integer MAD) as interim rule pending human decision. For peinture and nettoyage, minimum floors (800/200/1000) often dominate for typical small jobs, making rounding moot. For large jobs, integer MAD is accurate enough.

validation: fixed_amount_mad must be positive integer
No quantity input required
FORMULA-FIXED-V1.rounding: NONE — fixed price is integer by definition

FORMULA-CONDITIONAL-FIXED-V1.expression: if (eligibility_check = PASS) FINAL_PRICE = fixed_amount_mad; else ROUTE_TO_QUOTE_OR_SCOPE_CHANGE
validation: eligibility_result must be PASS before applying price
On FAIL: scope-change protocol POL-HORS-PERIMETRE-V1 applies
quantity must be positive integer
unit_rate_mad must be positive integer

FORMULA-UNIT-WITH-FLOOR-V1.expression: CALCULATED = unit_rate_mad × quantity; FINAL_PRICE = max(minimum_floor_mad, CALCULATED)
validation: minimum_floor_mad is NON_ADDITIVE — never add to CALCULATED
quantity may be decimal (m²) — rounding applied to CALCULATED before floor comparison
minimum_floor_mad must match frozen métier floor policy
FORMULA-UNIT-WITH-FLOOR-V1.rounding: ROUND_TO_NEAREST_INTEGER_MAD after multiplication, before floor comparison (pending human decision)

FORMULA-TIME-SINGLE-V1.expression: CALCULATED = rate_per_hour_mad × hours; MINIMUM_PAYABLE = rate_per_hour_mad × minimum_billing_hours; FINAL_PRICE = max(minimum_payable_mad OR metier_floor_mad, CALCULATED)

constants.note: Always 1 artisan. MUST NOT multiply by worker_count.

validation: worker_count is always 1 — forbidden to parameterize
hours must be >= minimum_billing_hours
MUST NOT be used with PER_CLEANER_HOUR unit
minimum_payable_mad = rate × minimum_billing_hours

FORMULA-TIME-TEAM-V1.expression: TOTAL_CLEANER_HOURS = worker_count × hours; CALCULATED = rate_per_cleaner_hour_mad × TOTAL_CLEANER_HOURS; FINAL_PRICE = max(minimum_floor_mad, CALCULATED)
validation: worker_count is explicit client input — MUST NOT be hardcoded to 1
MUST use PER_CLEANER_HOUR unit — MUST NOT use PER_HOUR
minimum_floor is NON_ADDITIVE
MUST NOT be used for bricolage or any single-worker service

FORMULA-MINIMUM-FLOOR-V1.expression: FINAL_PRICE = minimum_floor_mad (service IS the floor — no other variable calculation)
validation: This formula applies when the service itself is the minimum-visit anchor (BRIC-001, NET-001, PEIN-001)
MUST NOT add to other service prices
Anti-additive: if booking another service that already exceeds floor, this service does not stack
FORMULA-MINIMUM-FLOOR-V1.rounding: NONE — fixed floor amount is integer by definition

FORMULA-LABOUR-PART-SEPARATE-V1.expression: FIXEO_LABOUR_PRICE = labour_amount_mad (fixed); HARDWARE_PRICE = artisan_disclosed_and_client_approved; TOTAL = labour_amount_mad + HARDWARE_PRICE
validation: labour_amount_mad is the FIXEO contractual component
HARDWARE_PRICE is NOT part of the FIXEO price — it is variable and separately disclosed
Client must approve hardware price before installation
TOTAL is informational only — FIXEO guarantees only the labour component
FORMULA-LABOUR-PART-SEPARATE-V1.rounding: NONE for labour component (fixed integer). Hardware disclosed at actual cost.

examples.hardware: cylinder — client-supplied or artisan-disclosed at disclosed price
hinge 20-120 MAD/unit — disclosed, approved before installation

FORMULA-ADDON-V1.expression: ADD_ON_PRICE = add_on_rate_mad × quantity; must be attached to primary service
validation: Cannot be booked standalone
Primary service must be active in same booking
Total = primary_service_price + add_on_rate × quantity

FORMULA-DIAGNOSTIC-V1.expression: STANDALONE: FINAL_PRICE = diagnostic_price_mad; ABSORBED: CREDIT = diagnostic_price_mad applied against qualifying repair per métier absorption policy
validation: diagnostic_price_mad is NOT a minimum floor — it does not constrain other service prices
Absorption only under explicitly frozen per-métier conditions
Absorption rules are independently defined per métier — MUST NOT be generalized
same_visit_required = true for all three métier diagnostics
FORMULA-DIAGNOSTIC-V1.rounding: NONE — diagnostic price is fixed integer

validation: fixed_amount_mad must be null
unit_rate_mad must be null
